title: The ordinary-double-point gap in every dimension
summary: We prove the ordinary-double-point gap conjecture for boundary-zero complex algebraic klt germs in every dimension: a singular n -dimensional germ has normalized volume at most $`2(n-1)^n`$, with equality precisely at an analytic ordinary double point.

review.reason: Proves the ordinary-double-point volume gap in every dimension for boundary-zero klt germs.
